user_query: I want to explore the news coverage about Cameroon. Retrieve the news articles from the Instant Cameroon News API. Include the title, description, source, and publication time for each article. Also, provide the homepage of the Instant Cameroon News website.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the homepage of the Instant Cameroon News website.
Query the Instant Cameroon News API to retrieve news articles covering Cameroon.
Extract the title, description, source, and publication time from each retrieved news article.
